summary: Ubuntu 9.04 (Jaunty Jackalope) was released on 23 April 2009. It introduced ext4 as the default filesystem. Notable additions: faster boot, Notify OSD for notifications, Empathy as default IM client, new themes (New Humanity icons, Dust Sand theme), Brasero improvements, and support for ARM architecture. Canonical targeted a 25-second boot time.
notes: Unsupported since 2010-10-23. Kernel 2.6.28. The jackalope (rabbit with antlers) was chosen as a playful mythical mascot.
